question: Mulayam Singh Yadav, who passed away in October 2022, served as the Chief Minister of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mulayam Singh Yadav served as the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh three times. His first term was from 1989 to 1991, the second from 1993 to 1995, and the third from 2003 to 2007.
 
• He was a prominent political leader and the founder of the Samajwadi Party, a major political party in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Mulayam Singh Yadav played a significant role in Uttar Pradesh's politics and was known for his influence among the backward classes and minorities.
 
• Under his leadership, various social and economic policies were implemented in Uttar Pradesh aimed at improving the welfare of the underprivileged sections of society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chief Minister**:

 
 
• The Chief Minister is the head of the government at the state level in India.
 
• He/she is responsible for the administration of the state and the implementation of state policies and laws.
 
• The Chief Minister is appointed by the Governor of the state, usually the leader of the majority party or coalition in the state legislative assembly.
 
 
 
• **Samajwadi Party**:
 
 
• The Samajwadi Party is a political party in India primarily based in the state of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It was founded on October 4, 1992, by Mulayam Singh Yadav.
 
• The party's ideology is based on socialism and it aims to promote social justice and equality.
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**:
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India, located in the northern part of the country.
 
• The capital of Uttar Pradesh is Lucknow, and it is known for its rich cultural heritage and historical significance.
 
• Uttar Pradesh plays a crucial role in Indian politics due to its large number of parliamentary and legislative assembly seats.
